show.title: Soulection All Day 2022
show.content:
**🎊🌟 Happy New Year 2022 🌟🎊**

A day of exclusive mixes from [Joe Kay](/episodes/all-day-2022/#joe-kays-set), [Kirou Kirou](/episodes/all-day-2022/#kirou-kirous-set), [Mojvki](/episodes/all-day-2022/#mojvkis-set), and [Yukibeb](/episodes/all-day-2022/#yukibebs-set)



<!--more-->


#### Jump to:

- [Joe Kay](/episodes/all-day-2022/#joe-kays-set) - Los Angeles 🇺🇸
- [Kirou Kirou](/episodes/all-day-2022/#kirou-kirous-set) - Paris 🇫🇷
- [Mojvki](/episodes/all-day-2022/#mojvkis-set) - Johannesburg & Cape Town 🇿🇦
- [Yukibeb](/episodes/all-day-2022/#yukibebs-set) - Tokyo 🇯🇵


Also listen to [Soulection All Day 2021](/episodes/all-day-2021/), [Soulection All Day 2020](/episodes/all-day-2020/), or [Soulection All Day 2019](/episodes/all-day-2019/).

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #490 (The Discord Choice)
show.content:
Music chosen by the Soulection Discord community.

<!--more-->

👉 [Join Soulection Discord](https://discord.gg/soulection) 👈

The community all groups together on an audio channel and listens to the newest Soulection Radio every week, along with organisation selected tracks and the occasional mix-set. 

In case you missed it, the Discord community hosted [Soulection Appreciation mixes](https://soundcloud.com/meeshellaneous/sets/soulection-discord) to celebrate 10 years of Soulection.

_Big shout out to all the moderators and day-1 discord gang, you know who you are._


Listen to other [The Peoples Choice](/episodes/the-peoples-choice) episodes.
